purpose: Collect a one-time verification code in one named text field drawn as per-character slots, with Input's label, validation, and form behavior.

notes: Use VeliProvider for the Optional caption and direction. Pass composeOTPValidate when a live completeness message is wanted.

useWhen: A sign-in, verification, or recovery flow asks for an SMS, email, authenticator, or backup code of known length.

avoidWhen.situation: The value has no fixed length or is free text.
The value is a credential the user chose.

supportedInteractions: Typing appends or overtypes one slot and moves right
Backspace and Delete remove a character and later characters shift left
Arrow keys, Home, End, and slot clicks move the caret
Pasting a full code replaces the value; a shorter paste inserts at the caret
approvedPatterns: Use the flat props. Pass length or groups, never both; groups sets the slot count.
Use renderSlot and separator only to restyle the track the root maps. renderSlot should return OTPInputSlot for the slot it receives.
Use onComplete for auto-submit. It fires from the user edit that fills the code, never from a controlled value change.
Inside Form, leave errorMessage unset so validationErrors keyed by name show through the field error.
Put a Resend button in action.
limitations: The value is a dense string. There are no empty slots between filled ones.
Range selection, including select-all, is not supported.
Alphabets are digits, alphanumeric, and alphanumeric-upper. The alphabet owns inputMode and pattern.
Root className only changes complete-field width.
accessibility: Uses React Aria TextField, Label, and one Input, so assistive technology hears a single labelled text field.
An empty required field uses isRequired. Partial codes are not live-invalid unless the caller passes validate.
responsive: The field fills its container and the slots keep a fixed size on the start edge.
rtl: The label, helper, and error follow the active direction.
The slot row and the value stay left to right on Dhivehi pages.
